article_title: Embraer Launches Phenom 300EV, the Largest Business Jet to Carry Garmin's Emergency Autoland System
summary: Submission approvable with 1 minor warning(s) — file a corrections record on merge

findings.details: The article's 'Executive comment' section attributes the quote "With the new Phenom 300EV, we are raising the bar once again" to Michael Amalfitano, citing AVweb (source-0). This exact quote does not appear anywhere in the AVweb snapshot, nor in any of the other three cited source snapshots (AeroXplorer, Corporate Jet Investor, AVITRADER). The AVweb article does not quote Amalfitano at all. The second quote in the same paragraph, attributed to AeroXplorer, IS verified verbatim in the AeroXplorer snapshot. Only the first quote is fabricated/hallucinated.

findings.message: 'What We Don't Know' section incorrectly frames a fact that is answered by a cited source
findings.details: The article states Embraer 'has not said whether current Phenom 300E owners will have any retrofit path to the new Multi-Purpose Electronic Controller or Autobrake system.' However, Corporate Jet Investor (one of the article's own cited sources, source-2) explicitly states: 'Because of these changes, it will not be possible to upgrade an existing Phenom 300E to a Phenom 300EV.' The answer is not unknown -- it was reported as 'no' by a source already cited elsewhere in the same article.

content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Embraer launched the Phenom 300EV on July 14, 2026, an updated version of its best-selling light business jet, headlined by the addition of Garmin's Emergency Autoland system, according to [AVweb](https://avweb.com/aviation-news/embraer-phenom-300ev-emergency-autoland/). Embraer said the Phenom 300EV will be the largest business jet equipped with the system, according to [AVweb](https://avweb.com/aviation-news/embraer-phenom-300ev-emergency-autoland/) and [AVITRADER](https://avitrad...

editor_notes.content_quality: Well-organized News piece with clear section headers (Overview, What We Know with subsections, What We Don't Know). Neutral, professional tone throughout with no editorializing or sensationalism. No AI self-reference detected. Word count (485) fits the News category range (400-1200).
editor_notes.source_verification: All four snapshots were read in full from sources/2026-07/embraer-launches-phenom-300ev-the-largest-business-jet-to-carry-garmins-emergency-autoland-system/: source-0.html.gz (AVweb, sha256 verified match), source-1.html.gz (AeroXplorer, sha256 verified match), source-2.html.gz (Corporate Jet Investor, sha256 verified match), source-3.html.gz (AVITRADER, sha256 verified match). All returned HTTP 200 with no archive fallback. aeroxplorer.com, corporatejetinvestor.com, and avitrader.com are not in config/source_allowlist.txt (only avweb.com is), but all three are established, credible business-aviation trade publications with clear bylines and editorial standards; this is a config gap, not a credibility concern.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Nearly every specific claim was traced to its cited source and confirmed verbatim or near-verbatim: launch date (July 14, 2026), 'largest business jet' claim (AVweb + AVITRADER), price $13,995,000 (AeroXplorer + CJI), range 2,010->2,055nm (AVweb), performance specs -- 464kt cruise, 3,209ft runway, 45,000ft ceiling, 10 seats, PW535E1 engines (AeroXplorer, verbatim match), +430lb payload (AVITRADER), avionics upgrades (AVweb, verbatim match), MEC/rudder-by-wire (AVITRADER), Gogo Galileo/Starlink (AVweb), cabin updates (AVweb), triple certification target ANAC/FAA/EASA 2026 and 2028 deliveries (CJI + AVweb), and the delivery track record 930+ units since Dec 2009, 72 in 2025, 35 in H1 2026 (CJI, verbatim match). Two issues were found: (1) the first executive quote ('With the new Phenom 300EV, we are raising the bar once again,' attributed to AVweb) is fabricated -- it appears in none of the four sources, and AVweb does not quote Amalfitano at all; the second quote in the same paragraph (attributed to AeroXplorer) is verified verbatim. (2) The 'What We Don't Know' section incorrectly claims Embraer has not addressed a 300E-to-300EV retrofit path, when Corporate Jet Investor -- a source cited elsewhere in the same article -- explicitly states no such upgrade path will exist. Both issues are isolated, do not touch the headline/summary/lead (which are solidly sourced), and can be honestly corrected in a public corrections note.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and professional throughout. No loaded language, no sensationalism, no unsupported editorializing.
editor_notes.originality: No prior Machine Herald coverage of Embraer or the Phenom 300 family was found in src/content/articles/ (checked via grep across all months and the last several days of July 2026 output). This is a genuinely new topic with no duplicate or overlap concerns.
concerns: Fabricated executive quote attributed to AVweb, not found in any of the four cited sources -- addressed via corrections record.
'What We Don't Know' section states the 300E retrofit path is undisclosed when Corporate Jet Investor (a cited source) explicitly says no retrofit path will exist -- addressed via corrections record.

aeroxplorer.com, corporatejetinvestor.com, and avitrader.com are not yet in config/source_allowlist.txt; recommend adding them given they are legitimate, credible aviation trade publications used repeatedly in aviation coverage.
recommendations: File a corrections record documenting the fabricated quote and the incorrect 'unknown' framing of the retrofit question.

Add avitrader.com, corporatejetinvestor.com, and aeroxplorer.com to config/source_allowlist.txt after confirming editorial standards, to avoid repeat allowlist warnings for legitimate aviation trade press.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Substantively strong, well-sourced News article with accurate figures and specs across all major claims, headline, summary, and lead. One fabricated quote and one inaccurate 'unknown' framing were found, both isolated to subordinate sections and both honestly correctable in a single public corrections note. Verdict: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS.
